title: Arrow of Ice
summary: Fire one arrow from a ranged weapon. It deals weapon damage plus a 2d4 Cold burst (DC 12 Dexterity negates the Cold) and leaves a 7 ft-radius ice surface for 2 turns.

fields.Activation: Action with a ranged weapon. Consumes one arrow.
fields.Damage: Weapon damage plus a 2d4 Cold burst. A DC 12 Dexterity save negates the Cold damage. The source gives a radius for the ice surface and leaves the burst radius, bystander targeting, and behavior on a miss unspecified.
fields.Ice: 7 ft radius, 2 turns. The initial Prone check uses a separate DC 12 Dexterity save. The remaining ice is difficult terrain and uses the shooter’s spell save DC from their most recently acquired class for subsequent slip checks.
fields.Base value: 10 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Acquisition: Available from merchants including Arron in the Druid Grove. Also listed as Ranger starting equipment.
fields.Creative use: Aim where the ice can slow a group’s approach. Plan around the ice when moving allies.

changes: Added reviewed BG3 ammunition rules, separate cold and ice saves, surface details and pinned sources.
